def Q(model, x, radial=False):
    """x: (N, >=9); only x[:, :9] used. Returns exact P(correct | x0..x8).
    radial=True: also integrate the prefix's scale. The net has no biases, so correctness is invariant under
    x -> c x (c>0); with x0..8 = R u (R^2 ~ chi2_9 independent of u, x9), correctness depends on (u, x9/R), and
    3 x9/R ~ Student t_9. Returns exact P(correct | direction of x0..x8)."""
    Wi, Wh, Wo = model
    x = x[:, :9]
    N = len(x)
    if radial:
        x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        cdf = lambda z: stdtr(9, 3 * z)
    else:
        cdf = ndtr
    a = h9(model, x) @ Wh.T
    w = Wi
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore'):
        bp = np.where(np.abs(w)[None] > 1e-12, -a / w[None], np.nan)
    o = np.argsort(-x, 1)
    q1, q2 = (o[:, 0], o[:, 1])
    m1 = x[np.arange(N), q1]
    m2 = x[np.arange(N), q2]
    pts = np.concatenate([bp, m1[:, None], m2[:, None]], 1)
    pts = np.where(np.isnan(pts), np.inf, pts)
    pts = np.sort(pts, 1)
    edges = np.concatenate([np.full((N, 1), -np.inf), pts, np.full((N, 1), np.inf)], 1)
    total = np.zeros(N)
    idx = np.arange(N)
    for k in range(edges.shape[1] - 1):
        lo, hi = (edges[:, k], edges[:, k + 1])
        ok = hi > lo
        if not ok.any():
            continue
        mid = np.where(np.isinf(lo), hi - 1, np.where(np.isinf(hi), lo + 1, (lo + hi) / 2))
        mid = np.where(np.isinf(mid), 0.0, mid)
        D = a + w[None] * mid[:, None] > 0
        A = D * a @ Wo.T
        B = D * w[None] @ Wo.T
        tgt = np.where(mid > m1, q1, np.where(mid > m2, 9, q2))
        At = A[idx, tgt][:, None]
        Bt = B[idx, tgt][:, None]
        dA = At - A
        dB = Bt - B
        dA[idx, tgt] = 1.0
        dB[idx, tgt] = 0.0
        with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            r = -dA / dB
        lower = np.where(dB > 0, r, -np.inf)
        upper = np.where(dB < 0, r, np.inf)
        never = (dB == 0) & (dA <= 0)
        L = np.maximum(lo, lower.max(1))
        U = np.minimum(hi, upper.min(1))
        mass = np.where((U > L) & ok & ~never.any(1), cdf(U) - cdf(L), 0.0)
        total += mass
    return total

NS = len(EDGES)

def pstratum(x):
    s = -np.sort(-x[:, :9], 1)
    m1, m2, m3 = (s[:, 0], s[:, 1], s[:, 2])
    g = np.minimum((m1 - m2) / np.abs(m1), (m2 - m3) / np.maximum(np.abs(m2), 1e-12))
    b = 1 + np.clip(np.searchsorted(EDGES, g, side='right') - 1, 0, NS - 2)
    return np.where(m2 <= 0, 0, b)

def draw_all(nh, rng, batch=50000):
    """Pooled rejection: one iid candidate stream, each candidate goes to its own stratum; stop when every
    stratum has its quota. Candidates needed ~ n * max_h(a_h/P_h) (~2.6 n) instead of sum_h (~10 n)."""
    out = [[] for _ in nh]
    got = np.zeros(len(nh), int)
    drawn = 0
    while (got < nh).any():
        x = rng.standard_normal((batch, 9))
        h = pstratum(x)
        drawn += batch
        for j in np.nonzero(got < nh)[0]:
            xj = x[h == j][:nh[j] - got[j]]
            out[j].append(xj)
            got[j] += len(xj)
    return ([np.concatenate(o) for o in out], drawn)
